node.statement: Degree-two finish and coefficient closure. Put P4:=Phi_n(Delta_n(XY) Delta_n Z) and P5:=Delta_n(XYZ). Because eta <= rho_3 <= rho_2, two applications of lem-routef-degree-two-estimate, first to X,Y and then to XY,Z, plus complete contractivity, give ||P3-P4|| <= C_2 eta||X||||Y||||Z|| and ||P4-P5|| <= C_2 eta||X||||Y||||Z||. Therefore the five successive bounds sum to [6d/eta+10+2C_2]eta times the norm product; using d/eta=2(C_theta+C_Delta) and C_2=C_Delta'+4C_Delta gives 10+12C_theta+20C_Delta+2C_Delta'=C_3.
